card.name: Cross-reference brackets before section names
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas or the word 'see' inside bracketed cross-references in drug labels, just before the next section name or number. Typical spots are after 'see Boxed Warning' or at the opening of a '(5.1)' reference.

modes.label: Joiner after Boxed Warning
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma right after 'see Boxed Warning' in a bracketed cross-reference, before the next section name.

modes.label: Start of section number
modes.description: The space or opening parenthesis or the word 'see' just before a section number or section name in a reference.
